summary: Batched simulator parity with the CPU reference and the gpu-marked test suite on one Modal Tesla T4, plus one synthetic training-pipeline measurement. Parity is agreement between two implementations of the same rules; the training measurement shows no GPU speedup at eight environments.

training_pipeline_benchmark.reading: Synthetic data, one repeat. At eight environments the batched CUDA backend is slower end to end than serial CPU. The device-only batched core costs about 3-4 ms per vector step from batch 8 to batch 4096, so a near-constant per-step device cost, not the batch's work, dominates at small batches; the measurement does not separate launch latency from synchronisation. No speedup is claimed.
